final: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), total_val AS (SELECT COUNT(*) as tot FROM telescopes), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, (cnt * 100.0 / (SELECT tot FROM total_val)) as share_pct FROM counts), avg_share_val AS (SELECT AVG(share_pct) as avg_pct FROM shares), above_avg AS (SELECT cnt, share_pct FROM shares WHERE share_pct > (SELECT avg_pct FROM avg_share_val)) SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_telescopes, AVG(share_pct) as average_share_percent, AVG(share_pct - (SELECT avg_pct FROM avg_share_val)) as average_excess_above_avg FROM above_avg
